content: Kirstoosi Issito Mernaas Shiishshida Yarsho

Muse wogay buro sinththara yaana lo7o hanotas eeshoppe attiin tumu adda medhay izas deenna; hessa gishshas layththan layththan pacey baynda shiri shiri shiishshiza yarshoy Xoos goynnanaas shiiqiza asaa geeshshanaas mulekka dandaybeenna.
As mulera geeshshana dandayzayssa gididaakko istti yarsho yarshanayssa aggettenee? Qasseka Xoos goynnana shiiqiza asay issito geeyzaakko ba wozinara nagaranchcha gididayssa sidhana.
Gido attiin heyti yarshoti layththan layththan nagara zaari zaari qofseettes.
Gaasoykka wofanotanne deyshata suuththi asappe nagara digganaas dandayenna.
Hessa gishshas Kirstoosi hayssa ha alameza yiidi,
Muse wogay hessi hessaththo hanana mala azazikkoka izi qasse koyro, «Yarsho, imota, xuugettiza yarshonne nagara gishshas shiiqiza yarsho ne koyabeekkanne izan ufayettabeekka» gees.
Kaaleththidikka, «Hekko ta ne shene ooththana yadis» gides. Nam7anththoza essanaas koyroyssa diggides.
Hayssan, «Iza shene» giza qaalaa mala hara yarsho zaareth shiishshanaas koshshontta mala Yesus Kirstoosa baggara issito shiiqida yarshon geeyidos.
Qeesey hach hach eqqidi ba ooso polees; as nagarappe geeshshanaas dandayonttayta wontiin wontiin shiishshees.
Kirstoosi gidikko yarsho issito mernaas gidanayssa shiishshidi Aawaa ushachchan uttides.
He gallassafe simmiin iza morkketi iza toho garsan yedhettana gakkanaas naagon dees.
Gaasoykka issito shiishshida yarshon geeyana asata mernaas geeshshides.
Hessa he hanoza gishshas Xillo Ayanaykka nuus markkattees. Goday koyro,
Qasseka, «Ta istta nagaraanne
Heytantti wurikka atto geetettidaappe guye nam7anththo nagaras shiiqana hara yarshoy deenna.
Wurseth Gakkanaas Minni Daana Mala Shiiqida Xeys
Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Nuni Yesus Kirstoosa suuththaa baggara gede ubbaafe dumma geesh geetettizasoyo gelanaas xalateth demmidos.
Hessika magalasha baggara; izi ba asho baggara nuus doyda ooraththinne de7o gidida ogenna.
Xoossa Keeththa bolla shuumettida qeeseta halaqay nuus diza gishshas,
nuni nu iita qofaappe geeyanaas nu wozina aracettidi nu asateththaaka xillo haaththan meecettidi tumu wozinappenne kumeththa ammanon Xoossaako ane shiiqoos.
Nuus hidota qaalaa immidaadey ammanettizaade gidida gishshas nuni ammanidi iza gishshas markkattiza hidotappe yaanne haa gontta ane lo7eththi oykkoos.
Siiqoninne lo7o ooson nu minni daana mala ane issoy issaa qofsoos.

Ane nu ubba gallas issoy issaara gakki gakki issoy issaa minththeththoos attiin issi issi asati shiiqo aggida mala ane nuni shiiqoza aggoko; harappeka Godaa Yesusi matattidayssa qoppishe kaseppe minni shiiqite.
Nuni tumaa shaakki eridi ekkidayssafe guye erishe nagara ooththiko hayssafe guye nagara gishshas shiiqanaas hara yarshoy deenna.
Haray buro hanana daro babisiza pirday Xoossa morkketa xuuggana naagiza mino tamay xalla dees.
Muse wogaa kadhida asi nam7u woykko heedzdzu markkati markkattiko maaroy baynda hayqon qaxxayettees.

Histtiin Xoossa naa kadhida asi izan geeyida caaqo suuththaa hiraysso miishsha mala qoodidaadessinne iza kiyateththaa Ayana iiseththidaades ay mala hessafe aadhdhiza pirday izas bessizaa inttes misatizee?
«Tani izas halo kessana; izaade ooso mala izaades ta zaarana» gidayssa nu eroos. Qasseka, «Goday ba dereza bolla pirdana» gees Goday.
De7o Xoossaa kushen kundeththi daro babisees.
Inttes issito poo7oy poo7idaappe guye meto wode daro baaxen intte kase minni eqqida beni wodeza yuushshi qopite.
Issi issi wode intte dere duulata sinththan cashshassinne goodeteththas aadhdhi imettideta; qasse hara wodekka hessa mala waayey istta bolla gakkida asatara intteka issife waaye beyideta.
Intte inttes harappe aadhdhiza mernaas daana haaroy dizayssa eriza gishshas qashettidaytas mishettidetanne intte haaroy bonqqettishin ufayssan dandaydeta.
Hessa gishshas gita waagay diza kase intte ammaneteththaa aggofte.
Intte Xoossa shene polidi izi inttes immida ufayssa qaalaa ekkanaas minni eqqanaas inttena koshshees.
Gaasoykka guuththa wodeppe kaallidi, «Yaanayssi izi yaana; gam7enna;»
xillo asi gidikko ammanon de7o demmana; guye undudizaadey diikko ta shemppoya izaade bolla ufayettuku.
«Nuni gidikko ammanidi attidayta bagga attiin gede guye undudi dhayzayta bagga gidokko» gides.
